constant_key_translation.interpretation: Raw-key energy used for S_v is not invariant to an exact constant key translation; this is a limitation of the proxy, not evidence of a mismatched official formula or model cause.

query_order.changed: reverse query token order with fixed K/V
query_order.interpretation: Recipe3 second-moment statistics discard query-time correspondence and cannot certify attention output fidelity.

cache_sampling_identity.interpretation: Sampling-provenance gap when execution configuration changes; not evidence that current fixed-TP4 quality loss is caused by this gap.

norm_preserving_key_translation.interpretation: Every key has the same squared norm before and after translation; native attention and centered K are exactly equal, yet V rotation and quantized replay SSE differ. In this case SSE decreases rather than increases. The two examples establish non-invariance without claiming a uniform benefit from replacing the proxy.

source_checks.capture: Native Qwen query/key are RMS-normalized and RoPE-transformed before self.attn; RotationCaptureWorker hooks impl.forward and observes those tensors once before native attention.
source_checks.statistics: FP64 grouped-query Gram per global KV head; raw-K quadratic energy weights V covariance; separate K mean; unit trace/D normalization only for Q covariance.
source_checks.loading: Complete hashed K/V/combined generation, model identity, profile, matrix equality and orthogonality checked; global KV-head index selected by TP rank.
source_checks.reference_availability: Current references directory contains vllm and vllm-ascend only. Official OSCAR source bytes are absent. Prior reports preserve source hashes/comparison evidence; this audit does not claim fresh direct parity with unavailable source.

strategy_ranking.direction: Future offline experiment: centered-K energy for V covariance, with unchanged recipe3 baseline and actual held-out attention checks.

strategy_ranking.cost: Same covariance/eigh order; retained K/V/QGram sufficient to propose a matrix, but those statistics alone cannot validate attention quality.
